# ❤ 𝕎𝕖𝕝𝕔𝕠𝕞𝕖❤

Welcome to a world of miss spellings and crazy snow! We currently have a sister guild EratticSnowSis. If the main is full feel free to apply there!
We are very friendly and we love chatting about anything and tend to be pretty hardcore grinders of any game (╯°□°)╯︵ ┻━┻! 

# Our Discord 
### https://discord.gg/3SuqtQaxfH
Feel free to join the discord first before you join us! See if we are a good fit for you! If you do join the guild, we require you to join the discord. If you wish to be accepted sooner, joining the discord will get you a fastest response to join the guild. It is mainly for communication reason. Once the game has a communication system we will delete this message!!!! :D

## ✉ Message To the guild ✉ 

Don't feel stressed about completing challenges. Donate what you can. We are a relaxed guild, if we run low on marks will simply pause the guild raids for a day or 2 to build them up again!

### ⏳ Raid Time ⌛ 

1.  9:00 AM EST, 13:00 UTC
2. 3:00 PM EST, 19:00 UTC 

RAIDS OFF FOR NOW

### ☠ Rules for guild ☠ 

1.  ⚰ **Total Activity time in 7 days = 1440 minutes, or 1 Day.** ⚰ (Unless you communicate with us, you will be removed. I will check activity time Monday to Monday. Total active time for the week should be 1440 minutes. If you are training combat, for the week please communicate as it does no track properly, and for this I will check combat levels if active time seems low.)
2. ⚰ **Must be in discord.** ⚰ (We use this for communication currently. Weather its to fuss, complain, complement, make sales, or even hate on each other. If you aren't there we can't communicate with you. So, we will remove you. This rule will change once we have in game guild communication.)

### 🚑 Suggestions/Guild Strat 🚑 

1. **Challenges** - Donating to guild challenges gives us Marks, guild xp, and Guild mastery. Donating to this is the first thing you should to help the guild grow and be able to complete guild raids. The amount of items needed to complete the challenges is a bit ridiculous but that is why we all have to work together. The higher levels can focus on the high level items, while low levels do the low level stuff. We aren't asking you to spend the full day doing them all, just help a little!
2. **Marks/raids** -  are used to do raids. We currently need 2-3 marks per raid, which generates combat xp, guild xp, and guild mastery. Raids are the easiest way to level up the guild, however you also have to be the same combat level of the raid to join it. So make sure to grind combat levels.
3. **Guild Level** - The higher the guild level the more people we can recruit to help us with everything. Level also unlocks more challenges and new raids that generate more combat xp, guild xp, and guild mastery.
4. **Guild Mastery** - This is a way the game tracks how much you actually help in the guilds you are a part of. It carries over if you leave the guild so no worries there. Some people use to to assess if you are good fit for their guild, so make sure to grind it up a bit!
